requirements.text: * Technical depth sufficient to earn credibility directly with a sophisticated customer's engineering team — not a demo\-only or slide\-based technical presence.
* Direct, hands\-on experience owning a customer or partner relationship end\-to\-end, not just supporting one from behind a ticket queue.

* High agency and a strong generalist bent — comfortable moving across data, delivery process, and whatever else the problem needs, taking on problems beyond your defined scope without waiting to be asked.
* Startup experience, ideally as a founding or early engineer.
* A track record of improving how a team delivers, not just delivering yourself.
